title: Replaceable Cobblestone
description: Gives cobblestone proper tags to be replaceable by moss and sculk.
body:
# What does this datapack do?
Simple, it adds the two necessary tags to cobblestone to let it be turned into sculk or moss.
# Why do this?
Because I'm tired of my sculk farm breaking in a server I play on.
# Will there be more?
Potentially, as I plan to create a fully fledged mod with multiple other QoL features.
